faq.question: Who is Pranav Dwivedi in Rewa cricket?
faq.answer: Pranav Dwivedi (Pranav Pramod Dwivedi) is the franchise captain and premier all-rounder of Destroyers Cricket Club (DES) in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh. He led Destroyers to three consecutive championships in 2024, 2025, and 2026.

faq.question: What are Pranav Dwivedi's career batting and bowling statistics?
faq.answer: 1,435 runs at 57.4 average (SR 146.4, HS 102*, 14 fifties, 1 hundred) and 66 wickets at 16.3 average (Econ 5.48, BBI 8/39).

faq.question: What is Pranav Dwivedi's captaincy record against Dread Eleven?
faq.answer: 19 wins, securing 3 consecutive championships: 2024 (4-1), 2025 (5-0 clean sweep), and 2026 (3-2).
